observations.why: Imperative directive enacts authority-ranking: speaker commands erasure of knowledge, positioning self as one entitled to issue binding instructions to the record-keeper.
Imperative command to strip specific information from the record enacts authority-ranking — speaker claims unilateral power to order what the record must and must not retain.
Speaker asserts a definitive institutional fact that overrides and contradicts any prior record, enacting authority-ranking by claiming final say over what the official history is.

mints.name: DirectiveRecordErasure
mints.title: command to remove specified knowledge from the record
mints.frame: Is the speaker claiming unilateral authority to determine what the record must forget, rather than proposing or requesting?
